Tests invoke production validators, archive loaders, pool resume APIs, digest computation, and the real MTF composition wrapper; only the expensive evolution step is stubbed in focused recovery tests.
Graph traces and direct source inspection cover feature_contract_digest consumers, all current skip_if_valid callers, validate_onchain_feature_ranges callers, and run_mtf_composition callers.
